name: Aureon Global - 7-email give-first Hormozi sequence (Free Sample magnet: 3 done-for-you cold emails + 25 verified leads)
target: High-ticket B2B service firms that RUN ON LEADS, sell to OTHER BUSINESSES, and buy done-for-you. Primary niche: B2B marketing/growth/creative agencies and consultancies (retainers 3-20k/mo, 40%+ margin, perpetual need for pipeline, native DFY buyers, ICP is trivially sourceable so the free-sample promise is genuinely fulfillable). Secondary niches (same structure, own configs): managed-IT/MSP and cybersecurity firms; commercial service contractors (commercial cleaning, facilities, commercial solar and HVAC). Sourced via aureon_agencies_us.yaml / aureon_msp_us.yaml / aureon_commercial_svc_us.yaml.
voice_notes: GIVE-FIRST Hormozi $100M Leads structure, reworked 2026-07-24 from the real-estate wedge to high-ticket B2B DFY-outbound. THE MAGIC MAGNET: E1 leads with the free SAMPLE = a complete slice of the paid product (three ready-to-send cold emails written for their business + 25 verified leads in their exact ICP, name/company/direct email each). This is Hormozi magnet type 2 (free sample of the actual thing) AND type 3 (step one of the multi-step engine): completing it proves the machine and reveals the next problem (they can send 25 but need the engine for 2,500). E2 re-offer. E3 names the pain (SDR at 5-6k, shared bought lists, DIY outbound goes quiet) + names the mechanism. E4 the paid offer with a free trial (accurate to Aureon pricing: free trial then conditional setup, keep 40%+ framing). E5 binary yes/no. E6 second give (an inline outbound value tip plus a SAMPLE re-offer, no orphan keyword). E7 breakup, SAMPLE still open. One live keyword: SAMPLE, fulfilled by the dedicated two-phase engine sequences/aureon-sample.py (intake -> work order -> deliver), NOT fulfill-magnets.py. PROOF: {proof_line} optional merge, empty by default; the give itself is the live proof of competence. STRICT CHAR RULES (enforced by the char guard): NO apostrophes, em-dashes, en-dashes, smart quotes, ellipses, contractions, word-internal hyphens. Required merges: {greeting} {company}. Copy is written niche-agnostic (phrases like 'your best-fit clients', 'the right buyers') so the single sequence runs for all three niches; clone per niche only when sharper niche lines are wanted.
schedule_doc: delay_days = gap from prior step. 0,2,2,3,4,7,10 = cumulative day 0,2,4,7,11,18,28.

variants.subject: 3 cold emails for {company}, free
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

Straight offer, free.

Reply with the word SAMPLE and I write you three cold emails built for {company}, ready to send, plus a list of 25 verified leads in your exact target market, name, company, and direct email for each. Yours to keep and send yourself. No call, no card, no pitch to sit through.

Why free: we run done for you outbound for a small group of B2B teams, and this sample is the first thing we do for every one of them. It is the fastest way to show you the work is real instead of telling you.

You get three emails you can send today and 25 real leads to send them to. If they land, you will start wondering what a full engine pointed at your ideal clients would do. If they do not, you spent one word and you are out nothing.

Room for a few this week. Reply SAMPLE and I will get started.

variants.subject: why most outbound goes quiet
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

Here is the trap most B2B teams fall into with outbound.

You either hire an SDR at 5k or 6k a month who takes three months to ramp, or you buy a list that ten other companies bought the same day, or you try to run it yourself between client work and it goes quiet after two weeks.

We built our engine to remove all three. We run done for you cold email and social outreach so {company} gets booked calls with the right buyers, and you only show up for the calls. The finding, the writing, the sending, the follow up, all ours. {proof_line}

Worth 15 minutes to see how it runs?

variants.subject: a free trial for {company}
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

Here is the straight offer.

We take on a few B2B teams at a time and run the whole outbound engine for them, cold email and social, done for you. You get the booked calls, the copy, the lead sourcing, and a weekly numbers report.

We start with a free trial so you see real replies before you decide anything. No long contract. If it works we keep going. If it does not, you walk away with everything we built.

One closed client at your deal size usually pays for a year of this. Reply and I will show you exactly what the first 30 days would look like for {company}.

variants.subject: {company}, a clear yes or no
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

If we ran our outbound engine on {company} for a month, you got the booked calls, and you could stop any day and keep everything we built, would you try it?

A clear yes or a clear no both help me. If it is a no, tell me what would make it a yes and I will listen.

variants.subject: something you can use either way
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

Trial or no trial, here is one thing you can use today.

The biggest lift in cold outbound is not the copy, it is the list. Most teams email a bought list that ten others bought the same day, so the reply rate is dead before the first send. Build your own from scratch instead, one clean sourcing rule, verified emails only, and the same copy that got ignored starts getting answered. That one change is usually the whole difference.

If you want me to prove it on {company}, reply SAMPLE and I hand you three cold emails and 25 verified leads built exactly that way, free. Either way, that tip is yours to keep.

variants.subject: closing your file
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

I am closing your file at Aureon today.

If the timing is off for {company}, I understand. If the offer is off, tell me what would land and I will listen.

Either way, the sample still stands. Reply SAMPLE and I send you three cold emails and 25 verified leads for {company}, free, yours to keep.
